name: Watch-And-Help (WAH)
description: WAH is a challenge designed to test social intelligence in AI agents by requiring them to understand task goals from a single demonstration and collaborate with a human-like agent to complete complex household tasks efficiently in unseen environments.
reputation: A well-known benchmark in embodied and social intelligence research for evaluating goal inference and human-agent collaboration from demonstrations.
notes: Includes a multi-agent household environment VirtualHome-Social and evaluates AI agents with both human-like agents and real humans.
